name: clan-server-builder
description: Pick a game and features on a website; a Discord bot builds and runs the guild server.

scripts.build:libs: npm run build -w @csb/shared && npm run build -w @csb/db
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @csb/bot && npm run build -w @csb/api && npm run build -w @csb/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck -w @csb/bot -w @csb/api -w @csb/web
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test -w @csb/shared -w @csb/api
scripts.dev:bot: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @csb/bot
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:libs && npm run dev -w @csb/api
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:libs && npm run migrate -w @csb/db
